svg.title: Screens by intended role · Clinic Front-Desk Operations Platform — Master PRD
svg.desc: Grid of 7 application screens against the 7 roles the specification names for them: each screen appears under its one intended role, with its major actions and the requirements behind them. An empty cell is not a denial.
svg.text: Each screen sits under the role the specification names for it, quoted as written; a combined role is one role.
An empty cell means the specification names a different role for that screen, not that access is denied.
